subject.title: refactor: remove unnecessary readParamRaw wrapper in common.ts

question: Should OpenClaw accept this refactor-only wrapper deletion despite the contributor guide discouraging refactor-only PRs without a maintainer request?
rationale: The code shape is safe, but accepting or declining unsolicited cleanup is a maintainer intake policy choice, and the branch also needs contributor proof plus conflict resolution.

options.title: Close per refactor-only policy

options.title: Accept after refresh and proof
options.body: Require the contributor to rebase over current `main`, preserve the landed reader behavior, and add direct redacted helper proof before ordinary review.
